== [http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/ apers About Lojban]{ANAME()}papers{ANAME} ==

This directory contains miscellaneous papers about Lojban.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/4thtense th tense]:A lengthy discussion from Lojban List about the possibility of a 4th tense for Lojban to handle relativistic issues. (Short version: nothing changed.)

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/L1LONGRV.TXT 1 long review]:review of Loglan 1 (TLI Loglan) by Lojbab and Athelstan

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/lojban_parser_paper lojban parser paper]:A paper about Nick Nicholas's semantic analyser. Source code available at [http://www.lojban.org/files/software/analyser oftware analyser].

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/lujvo-making.htm ujvo making]:An introductory essay on the art of tanru making and using tanru to make lujvo.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/lujvopap.3 ujvo paper]:Nick Nicholas's paper on lujvo-making and lujvo place structures. A [http://www.lojban.org/files/reference-grammar/chap12.html shorter version] appears as part of the reference grammar.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/nsn_semantics_paper nsn semantics paper]:Another paper by Nick on Lojban compositional semantics.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/scrabble.unf crabble]:Playing Scrabble in Lojban: rules, and how to fix up a Scrabble set. Some lines longer than 80 characters.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/SW.BIB apir-whorf bibliography]:A series of bibliographic references for people interested in exploring the Sapir-Whorf Hypothesis

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/useoldL1.txt 1 adaptation]:An explanation of how to patch up Loglan 1 (1975 edition) to apply to Lojban instead. Probably obsolete, but of historical interest.

;[http://www.lojban.org/files/papers/zaho ojban aspects (zaho)]:A brief explanation of Lojban aspects.

== [http://www.lojban.org/files/history/ istorical Lojban Information] {ANAME()}history{ANAME} ==

This directory contains Lojban material which is primarily

of historical interest. Any technical information here should

be considered suspect with respect to the current language.

See also the older items in the [http://www.lojban.org/files/texts/archives/ ext archive] and [http://www.lojban.org/files/jl/ JL

issues] before JL10 for considerable historical

material.

Minutes of annual meetings of the membership (Microsoft

Word format) from 1992 through 1998 are here: [http://www.lojban.org/files/history/ANMTG892.DOC 992],

[http://www.lojban.org/files/history/ANMTG793.DOC 993],

[http://www.lojban.org/files/history/ANMTG794.DOC 994],

[http://www.lojban.org/files/history/ANMTG895.DOC 995],

[http://www.lojban.org/files/history/ANMTG896.DOC 996],

[http://www.lojban.org/files/history/ANMTG897.DOC 997],

[http://www.lojban.org/files/history/ANMTG798.DOC 998].

The original grammar synopsis (Oct 88) ([http://www.lojban.org/files/history/GRSYN.DOC rsyn.doc (grammar syntax doument 1])

and ([http://www.lojban.org/files/history/GRSYNTOC.DOC rsyntoc.doc (grammar syntax document 2]),

the ancestor of both the current reference grammar and the

textbook, may be found here, both in Microsoft Word

format.

The original Roget's category assignments to the gismu are

here ([http://www.lojban.org/files/history/R ROGETNEW.TX1]).

The October 1988 cmavo list ([http://www.lojban.org/files/history/CMAV1088.ZIP mavo 1088 (.zip)])

that went with the grammar synopsis, and the Feb 1990 cmavo

list ([http://www.lojban.org/files/history/CMAV0290.ZIP mavo 0290 (.zip)])

are here.

Various historical versions of the Lojban grammar, showing

its early evolution. The earliest complete grammar on file is

[http://www.lojban.org/files/history/G GRAMMAR.NEW] (28 Oct 1988). Also available are [http://www.lojban.org/files/history/G GRAMMAR.B17] (21 Nov 1988), [http://www.lojban.org/files/history/G GRAMMAR.E25] (28 Feb 1989), [http://www.lojban.org/files/history/G GRAMMAR.L23] (24 Sep 1989), [http://www.lojban.org/files/history/G GRAMMAR.506] (6 May 1990), and [http://www.lojban.org/files/history/G GRAMMAR.28] (1 July 1991) with its corresponding [http://www.lojban.org/files/history/B BNF.28].

The latter two are the earliest versions of the grammar as

modified by John Cowan.

A list showing the pre-1993 rafsi assignments side-by-side

with the final baselined set of rafsi may be found [http://www.lojban.org/files/history/bothraf.txt here].

Some miscellaneous writings by John Hodges ([http://www.lojban.org/files/history/H HODGES.ZIP])

and by David Twery ([http://www.lojban.org/files/history/T TWERY.ZIP])

may be found here. John Hodges wrote short essays mainly on

how we might promote Lojban to the world. David Twery wrote

text and invented words.

Finally, the announcement of the 10th anniversary of the

Lojban language development ([http://www.lojban.org/files/history/l lojban10.html])

may be found here.<br />

== {ANAME()}jl{ANAME}[http://www.lojban.org/files/jl/ ''jl'''] ==

This directory contains issues of ju'i lobypli

(JL), the Lojban journal through the last published

issue JL18. In addition ''le lojbo karni (LK)'' issues 8

through 11 are included because at that time LK was the news

component of JL. LK18 is also included, since it was

published a full year after JL18 and contains some news not

in JL18.

The format is plain ASCII, but many lines are longer than

80 characters. Please browse the directory to see what is

available.

== {ANAME()}graphics{ANAME}[http://www.lojban.org/files/graphics/ ''graphics'''] ==

This directory contains many Lojban-related graphics in

Windows .BMP and .ICO formats. Please browse the directory to

see what is available.

== {ANAME()}lojban-list{ANAME}[http://www.lojban.org/files/lojban-list/ ''lojban-list'''] ==

This directory contains the archives of Lojban List, a

mailing list dedicated to Lojban. To subscribe, send a blank

message to [http://www.lojban.org/resources/mailto:lojban-subscribe@onelist.com amp;lt;lojban-subscribe@onelist.com>].

Note that traffic levels vary wildly.

Files are named by year and month. If a given month is

missing, it is probably consolidated with a later month or not

yet uploaded. Because of apparent inconsistencies in the

automated archives due to missing and damaged messages,

starting in November 1998 the archives contain two separate

versions of each month's archive.

onelist.com has a searchable archive covering the period

since 5 November 1998 at [[h|http://www.onelist.com/archive/lojban]]

== {ANAME()}news{ANAME}[http://www.lojban.org/files/news/ ''news'''] ==

This directory contains 

current links to other pages of

interest to Lojbanists. The [http://www.lojban.org/files/news/projects.html projects

section of the FAQ] is kept updated here with current

status. Finally a copy of Evguenie Sklyanin's Lojban Links

pages, locally edited is [http://www.lojban.org/files/news/lojban.html here].

The original and unmodified version of that site can be linked

from [http://www.pdmi.ras.ru/~sklyanin/lojban.html here].
